Values.//: Flat, not nested: the TimerTrigger %binding% syntax resolves against a configuration key, and a nested key would need a colon the binding expression does not accept.
Values.//sets: Namespace id to published set name. A namespace with no entry here is still answered, under DefaultSetName suffixed with its id.
Values.//isbm: Off by default: the channel must exist before the listener can open a session against it. Turn on once the channel is provisioned.
